result.reason: The operative language eliminates Licensor’s unilateral seven-year renewal right and requires mutual written agreement, satisfying the preferred position; the CPI/3% cap is also compliant. However, the 30-day non-renewal mechanism is redundant where renewal requires affirmative mutual agreement, and limiting renewals to 12 months plus adding a fee cap goes beyond what is necessary under the mutual-agreement option. The revision also leaves duplicative and defective language in Sections II and III, including “mutual written of the parties,” reducing drafting quality, while otherwise preserving the unrelated termination provisions.
